title: Example: Add stellar payment gateway integration
body:
## Summary
Integrate the Stellar payment gateway to support XLM transfers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Stellar SDK initialised
- [ ] Send XLM transaction
- [ ] Receive and parse Stellar webhooks

title: Example: Improve error handling in payment flow
body:
## Summary
Add structured error boundaries in the frontend payment flow so partial failures do not blank the UI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Error boundary wraps each critical payment route
- [ ] User can retry or navigate to dashboard safely
